## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Fànzhìnǚ Shǒuyì jīng* (T567) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra by Dharmarakṣa 竺法護 ([竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7)). The protagonist *Fànzhìnǚ Shǒuyì* 梵志女首意 is a brahmin maiden whose name *Shǒuyì* 首意 may render Sanskrit *Mūrdhāgrabuddhi* or another name.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text in the wise-women genre. Translation dated to Dharmarakṣa's productive period (266–308 CE).
